issue_context.title: [Bug]: recordHar not exist when recording using codegen with HAR
issue_context.body: ### Version 1.42.0, but reproducible on latest ### Steps to reproduce run in CLI npx playwright codegen "https://www.google.com" --save-har=testing.har record some step ### Expected behavior we can run the test using step from codegen ### Actual behavior ### Additional context error code : Object literal may only specify known properties, and 'recordHar' does not exist in type 'Fixtures<{}, {}, PlaywrightTestArgs & PlaywrightTestOptions, PlaywrightWorkerArgs & PlaywrightWorkerOptions>'. ### Environment ```shell System: OS: macOS 14.6.1 CPU: (10) arm64 Apple M1 Pro Memory: 72.28 MB / 16.00 GB Binaries: Node: 21.7.3 - /opt/homebrew/bin/node npm: 10.5.0 - /opt/homebrew/bin/npm Languages: Bash: 3.2.57 - /bin/bash npmPackages: @playwright/test: ^1.42.0 => 1.47.2 ```
